arguments.Title: PC 자동 주행 검증 시작
arguments.Code: using UnityEditor; using UnityEditor.SceneManagement; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { if(EditorApplication.isPlaying) { result.Log("Already playing"); return; } if(!EditorSceneManager.SaveOpenScenes()) return; EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/CampusSim/Scenes/PC_Bootstrap.unity"); EditorApplication.isPlaying=true; result.Log("PC Bootstrap play requested"); } }
